title: Find every record at a rating
description: Implement matching(records, rating). Records are [id, score] with unique string IDs. Sort by score descending using your own quicksort, then use binary search to locate the matching range. Return matching IDs alphabetically; sorted() may be used only on the final ID list.
hints: Descending order reverses the binary-search comparisons.
source: Adapted workflow · VJC 2025 Task 1 / NYJC 2025 Task 2
